builds.name: Shadow Surge arrival ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Shadow Surge arrival within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Shadow Surge arrival within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Helper R3 RecastDamageCalc350+0.5AP; initial missile175+0.2AP excluded. AP/MR modifiers strengthen arrival packet. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

ceiling.finiteState: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. Marked enemy; one successful R2 arrival. Riftmaker fully ramped before measured packet. Loaded form: owner 100% HP, target 30% HP, Heartsteel earned HP 0, Rod stacks 0, prior champion combat 5s, Gathering Storm minute 30.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Shadow Surge arrival tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

No reset chain or initial missile; Gloom separate; primary delegates to helper. Raw statFormula=2/Stat identifiers remain source evidence until runtime mapping confirmed; no unspecified stats/stacks granted.
tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula:
Shadow excitedly surges forward, dealing @spell.VexR:RDamageCalc@ magic damage and marking the first enemy champion hit for 4 seconds.

Recast: Dash to the marked champion, dealing @spell.VexR:RecastDamageCalc@ magic damage on arrival.

If the marked champion dies within @spell.VexR:TakedownWindow@ seconds of taking damage from this Ability, its Cooldown is temporarily reset.

builds.name: Personal Space: AP self-shield
builds.summary: Investigate high one Personal Space self-shield output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Personal Space self-shield output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: W grants 50/75/100/125/150 + 0.75 AP shielding for 2.5 seconds, while the shockwave uses only 0.3 AP as damage. AP plus eligible shield-power and owner Visage modifiers therefore targets a different output from normal spell burst. Doom/Gloom effects are separate.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Reference enemy (not the recipient of this self effect): 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 30%, target HP 100%, observation 2.5s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Owner 30%, one fresh W and no prior or allied shield. Record actual AP, Dawncore conversion and initial capacity before damage. No passive fear, Gloom damage, E/R damage or item shield folded into capacity; the reference enemy is not the shield recipient.
